skill.name: theme-factory
skill.description: Use when styling an artifact — a slide deck, doc, report, or HTML landing page — with a cohesive, professional theme drawn from 10 presets or generated on the fly.
whenToUse: Applying a consistent color palette and font pairing to a slide deck before sharing it
Styling an HTML landing page, doc, or report so it reads as professionally designed
Picking from the 10 preset themes when the user wants a curated look without deciding every hex code
Generating a bespoke theme on the fly when none of the presets fit the artifact's audience

keyConcepts.explanation: Each theme bundles a cohesive color palette with hex codes, complementary header/body font pairings, and a distinct visual identity suited to a particular context and audience.
Curated set spanning Ocean Depths, Sunset Boulevard, Forest Canopy, Modern Minimalist, Golden Hour, Arctic Frost, Desert Rose, Tech Innovation, Botanical Garden, and Midnight Galaxy.
A visual catalog of all 10 themes shown to the user for selection. It is display-only — the skill instructs never to modify it, just to present it for viewing.
Show the showcase, ask for a choice, wait for explicit confirmation, then read the chosen theme file from themes/ and apply its colors and fonts consistently across the artifact.
When no preset works, generate a new theme in the same style from a basic description, name it descriptively, show it for review, then apply it like a preset.

apiReference.purpose: Install the theme factory skill for styling artifacts.

gotchas: Never modify theme-showcase.pdf; it is display-only and shown to the user purely for theme selection
Get explicit confirmation of the chosen theme before applying — don't assume from an offhand preference
Read the actual theme file from themes/ for exact hex codes and fonts; don't approximate the palette from memory
Apply the theme consistently across every slide or section — partial styling breaks the visual identity
When generating a custom theme, ensure proper contrast and readability, not just an attractive palette
